**STEP 6 - Grams:** Fruit pieces have a bulk density of about 0.6 g/ml. 95 ml × 0.6 ≈ 57 g. A per-grape check (11 grapes at roughly 5 g each ≈ 55 g) agrees, so I use about 55 g.

**STEP 7 - Energy:** Red grapes are about 69 kcal per 100 g. 55 g × 0.69 ≈ 38 kcal.

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** Eleven grapes in a small bowl is about 55 g and about 40 kcal, which is plausible for what is visible.
